title: Max and Lucy
text:
Lucy has a small dog. His name is Max. Max is brown and very happy. Lucy takes Max for a walk every morning.

Max needs food and water every day. Lucy gives him food at breakfast and dinner. She also brushes his fur on Sunday. Max likes to play with his ball.

questions.text: What is the name of the dog?
When does Lucy brush Max's fur?
How does Max probably feel when Lucy takes him for a walk?
Why does Max depend on Lucy?
options: She gives him food and care

vocabulary.definition: a short trip taken on foot
the thick hair that covers an animal's body
the first meal of the day, eaten in the morning

paragraph_translations: A Lucy tem um cachorro pequeno. O nome dele é Max. O Max é marrom e muito feliz. A Lucy leva o Max para passear todas as manhãs.
O Max precisa de comida e água todos os dias. A Lucy dá comida para ele no café da manhã e no jantar. Ela também escova o pelo dele no domingo. O Max gosta de brincar com a sua bola.
